description:
Get the input/output schema and auth mode (paid or SIWX) for a single endpoint.

Call this to see exactly what fields the request body expects and what the response contains.

Returns the schema from the origin's OpenAPI spec. Optionally pass sample_input_body to probe the endpoint live (without payment) for an exact price quote — do this when pricing is dynamic (range-based or variable), or when you're unsure about the input schema. Treat auth mode as advisory: fetch handles both SIWX and paid routes.

anyOf.description: Raw request body string. Passed through to the underlying fetch call as-is.
JSON object to be sent as the request body

body.description: Optional. A sample request body to probe the endpoint live (without payment) for exact pricing. Use when pricing is range-based or quote-based, or when you need to verify the input schema. Omit to get the static schema and advisory pricing from the spec.

headers.description: Additional headers to include as a key-value pair

method.description: HTTP method to check. If omitted, all methods declared in the spec are returned.

name: check_endpoint_schema
title: Check Endpoint Schema
